name: branch-nested-object-body-mismatch
description: branch's body condition does not match when the expected value is a nested object whose fields diverge from the captured value, falling to the default case instead of the first
yaml:
appId: com.test
name: branch nested object mismatch
proxy: optional
env: {}
---
- launchApp
- capture: "POST /login as: loginRsp"
- branch:
    from: loginRsp
    on:
      - match:
          body:
            "$.user":
              id: 1
              role: admin
        do:
          - screenshot: matched
    default:
      - screenshot: fallback
